tei:div.tei:p: gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: kye bla ma 'od dpag med mgon dang*// spyan rasagazigs dang mthu chen thob// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med la// gsol ba'adebs so dbang bskur stsol// ces lan gsum: yan lag bdun pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang : sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung : sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas: sems can thams bdag gi mgron du gnyer: byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: gsum mam tshig rjes ma gsum: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ bum pa 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: bde ba can gyi zhing khams yin: khyod kyi mgo la bzhag pa yis: snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong shog: oṃ āḥhrīḥswā hā: ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ: bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu blud: sku gzugs thogs la: hūṃ 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang : 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog: a mi dhe wa hrīḥ pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: gtor ma thogs la: hūṃ 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang: 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong shog: oṃ āḥhūṃ a mi dhe wa ā yu:sid+dhi hūṃ: kā ya wa ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: rdo rje thogs la: hūṃ 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon la: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi mgo la bzhag pa yis: 'od dpag med mgon dbang thob nas:

bde ba can du skyes bar shog: oṃ hrīḥswā hā: badz+ra dz+nya na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: lhung bzed thogs la: hūṃ 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon te: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang : 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog: oṃ bh+ruṃ swā hā: pu ṇ+ya gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: me tog thogs la: hūṃ bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rnams la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs: dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mdzad pa: snang mtha' mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: sa gzhi spos chus byug cing me tog bkram: ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla'i brgyan pa 'di: sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis: 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog: bkra shis//
